sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00) as they look to bounce back from their most recent loss. The league leaders, currently on 22 points from 10 games, face a struggling Alsager side anchored at the bottom with just 4 points. Sandbach then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00), another opportunity to extend their strong season that has yielded 7 wins, 1 draw, and 2 losses.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive: second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host Wednesfield Community on 10 October as they look to keep pace with Sandbach, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth await a trip to Eccleshall on 3 October. In-form Wolverhampton Casuals, currently on a three-game winning run, visit Wednesfield Community on 3 October in a potential clash of momentum. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host Crewe on 10 October following their recent run of form. The basement battle is dire: Widnes Town, pointless from 7 games, travel to Brereton Social on 3 October; Telford Town, with just 6 points, face New Mills on 10 October; and Alsager Town are anchored on 4 points. Brereton Social, despite recent struggles, host Widnes on 3 October before facing league leaders Allscott Heath on 10 October in a reversal. Other Saturday fixtures include Market Drayton Town v New Mills (3 Oct), Cheadle Heath Nomads v Telford Town (3 Oct), Crewe v Allscott Heath (3 Oct), Dawley Town v Stafford Town (3 Oct), Eccleshall v AFC Bridgnorth (3 Oct), Foley Meir v Bilston Town (3 Oct), and Shawbury United v Barnton (3 Oct). Midweek action sees Brereton Social v Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45). The 10 October card continues with Alsager Town v Shawbury United, Barnton v Dawley Town, Bilston Town v Crewe, Market Drayton Town v Widnes Town, Sandbach United v Cheadle Heath Nomads, Stafford Town v Wednesfield Community, and Telford Town v New Mills.
